## Merge hold released: both rulings answered

John answered both rulings that held this PR's merge (on LIN-4447, 13 Nov, 15:33Z):

1. **Passenger scope (`lin4447-r1-passenger-scope`): "Both: a person's Done and an outside merge."** The piece is built as planned, with the merged-landing row and `followsPerson: 'merged'` kept. The done-only fallback is retired.
2. **Recommend path and ladder (`lin4447-recommend-path-outside-merge`): "Accept: no new GitHub reads on the recommend path or ladder lane; add the fact later if a stuck case shows up."** No GitHub or provider read is added. Witness 5 pins the limit: an outside merge on a ticket still In Progress still routes the read.

The hold is gone, but the ordinary gates aren't. This PR merges only after a recorded review Approve and green `ci-success`. It also still waits on its blockers in the graph, LIN-4458 and LIN-4459.

I've recorded the rulings below this ticket's `## As asked` block and in LIN-4447's description.

## Survey open-0: LIN-4460 @ 0dbf2d4ea

**Why this will be hard: the ground has moved since the ticket was written.** The ticket was grounded on `4b5001ddf`. That commit is 52 commits behind `0dbf2d4ea`, and LIN-4458 (piece 2, #2435) merged at 18:08Z, four hours after the "nothing landed since" line. Several of the plan's premises are now stale:

- **The `setDone` bound is already landing-only.** The ticket keeps "no other unmerged PR among every cited PR (today's bound)" and says a landing-only relaxation would need its own witness. LIN-4458 made that relaxation (commit a4c1671db, plan-review note 3). `readCloseOutChain` now reads only the landing's PRs, so the `prStatuses` Map that reaches `closeOutSetsDone` (`lib/run-closeout-state.js:464`) contains landing PRs only. The input table's "every cited PR" rows for the check route and the stop-at lane are stale in the same way. Going back to every cited PR would mean adding reads, which the binding constraints forbid. So follow the code, and post the course change on LIN-4447 as the ticket asks.
- **Already retired:** index-aligned `prStatuses` (now a URL-keyed Map, and arrays are refused). Already supplied: `readTrail` exposes `closeOutOnTrail`, `landingHasNotesPr` and `auditAfterCloseOut` (`lib/run-trail.js:405-407`). `blindReadStep` still decides on `closeOutAfterReview`, which is a different fact from `closeOutOnTrail`, so the builder has to choose deliberately which one "no close-out on the landing" means.
- **Anchors have drifted.** The press route is at `routes/workspace-api-run-evidence.js:326`, not :350 (the check route's `setDone` is still at :300). "Row 196" is now line 202 of `lin-4438-blind-read-gate.test.js`. Waiting is a bullet list with no numbers, and nine entries have come or gone since grounding, so 17/18/20 must be found by their text: the stop-at precedence split, the bare reason literals, and `closeOutSetsDone` never asking the gate.

**The deeper difficulty: "which PR is the task's" still has two answers.** `deriveState` (`lib/run-evidence.js:75`) runs over `extractPrUrls`, which is every cited PR. It uses its own vocabulary (`no-pr`, `multiple-prs`, `unknown`, `merged`, `ready`, `pr-not-open`) and drives `done`, `checked.now` and `resolveRunPrRef`, which the dashboard's pr-state route reads. The box uses `CLOSE_OUT_STATUS` over the landing. A Waiting entry from LIN-4458's blind read calls moving the page and the CI-wake sweep onto the landing "a product decision touching several callers". Taking away `deriveState`'s status decision pulls that decision into this piece. When listing readers of `state.status`, the census should cover `lib/render-run-evidence.js:203`, `public/close-out.js:87-93` and `public/session.js:478-484`. The hits in `public/task-page.js` are a different `state` (run status), so they are false positives. A single decision function cannot fix a PR identity that is split upstream of it. This piece fixes the symptom, and the split stays.

**Precedence lives in three places today.** `deriveCloseOutState` lets merged and partial outrank the gate. `closeOutNotReady` re-asks the gate (`lib/close-out-readiness.js:173`), and `ladderNotReady` asks it a third time (:141). Ordering `CLOSE_OUT_REASONS` decides what the box shows versus what the guard refuses, so the agreement table is the real spec. The census targets are small: `byPersonCheck` appears 16 times in 5 files, and `closeOutWaitsOn` has 3 calls outside its owner.

**The Lessons budget is short.** `## Lessons` is 5,866 bytes as `tests/unit/area-notes.test.js` measures it, against a cap of 6,144, which leaves about 278 bytes. A Lesson of about 300 bytes does not fit unless a stale clause comes out first.

**What I'd do first:**
1. Post the delta on LIN-4447 before writing any code: the `setDone` bound and the surface-table rows already read the landing, two retirements are done, and the line anchors have moved. Ask whether `deriveState`'s every-cited-PR vocabulary is in scope, or should keep its status while only the close-out answer moves.
2. Write the agreement table as characterization against the code at `0dbf2d4ea` (box × both lanes × check × press × `blindReadStep`) before building `closeOutDecision`. The cells that disagree today are the list of changes this piece must name.

## Survey global: LIN-4460 @ 0dbf2d4ea

**The ground moved.** LIN-4458 (piece 2, #2435) landed on 4b5001ddf at 18:08Z. Against this base, parts of the ticket are stale:

- **Today's Done bound is the landing, not every cited PR.** `readCloseOutChain` reads only landing PRs. `closeOutSetsDone`'s "no other unmerged PR" was narrowed with a named witness (`lin-4458-trail-characterization.test.js:251`, plan-review note 3). The inputs table's "every cited PR" would reverse that, or add back PR reads LIN-4458 removed. Build on the landing and say so on LIN-4447.
- **Index-aligned `prStatuses` is already retired.** Statuses are a URL-keyed `Map`, and an array throws.
- **"Waiting 17, 18, 20" has shifted.** At this base those numbers are `mayCarryWake`, `testTransport` and `prRefsFromPark`. The entries meant are now **13, 14, 15** (the precedence split, the reason literals, `closeOutSetsDone` vs the gate). Deleting by number removes three unrelated entries silently.
- **Row 196 is now line 201.**
- **Lessons is at 5,855 bytes.** A 300-byte Lesson passes `NOTE_BYTE_CAP` (6,144, `tests/unit/area-notes.test.js`). Trim a stale clause, or keep the Lesson under about 285 bytes.

**The place.** It is improving fast: one trail reader (`lib/run-trail.js`), one landing, URL-keyed statuses. The gate's precedence still lives in three places. `deriveCloseOutState` lets a merge outrank the gate, `closeOutNotReady` asks the gate again, and `ladderNotReady` asks a third time. Add the reason literals, `REFUSED_REASONS`, and a `byPersonCheck` that two harbour callers (the guard, the merge recorder) set to `true`. This task lands exactly on that seam.

**Done the obvious way, it risks:**
- **An empty landing reads as merged.** "Every landing PR merged" is vacuously true on an empty landing, and Waiting 19 shows how a landing ends up empty (`#N`-only re-review). `followsPerson: 'merged'` needs an explicit non-empty landing, with a witness.
- **A third status vocabulary.** Nothing in `lib`, `routes` or `public` reads `evidence.state.status` (`ready`/`pr-not-open`). Only tests and the GET `/api/run-evidence` body do. Dropping it is cheaper than mapping it. Name the change to the body in the PR.
- **A fake actor.** `close-out-merges.js` uses the chain's reads, never its state. `actor: 'harbour'` there feeds a decision it throws away.
- **Census false hits.** The names also appear in comments (`recommendation-facts.js:453`, `workspace-api-run-evidence.js:39`, `dispatch-entrance.js:1305`). Scope the census to calls and imports, and fix those comments.
- **Two client painters.** `public/close-out.js` and `public/session.js` paint box statuses almost identically. A new status must reach both, and no test checks they agree.

**Better, at this task's cost.** Make `readCloseOutChain` reads-only (trail, statuses, stop-at), and have each surface call `closeOutDecision`. The recorder then fakes nothing, and one ordered `CLOSE_OUT_REASONS` removes the repeat gate asks. Edit Waiting 21 rather than removing it: `deriveState` still lists every cited PR.

**Better still, not this task's.** Whether the page's PR and the CI-wake sweep follow the landing (21). One client painter. The `#N` fallback (19). The foreign-PR limit (12).

## Autopilot: `lin4460-landing-bound-not-cut` settled as an engineering call

**Decision: keep the landing bound for `setDone` as a course change, not a cut.**

Why: LIN-4458 (#2435) already narrowed `closeOutSetsDone`'s "no other unmerged PR" check to the landing, with a named witness (`lin-4458-trail-characterization.test.js`, plan-review note 3). Returning to "every cited PR" would mean adding PR reads, which the binding constraints on LIN-4447 forbid. This is a question of code quality and system coherence, not product, money, authority or what to retire, so it is not one of John's rulings.

How to apply: build on the landing; the build says so in a comment on LIN-4447 (the parent asks for this wherever the code shows the plan is wrong). The size record stays at "no cuts".

Keep the landing bound as a course change, not a cut

— Ruling recorded via Harbour

## Review — LIN-4460

Reviewed PR [#2438](https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2438) at head `8aad24e35c4b4d513a08226d09ac0e4ab6257cb8` (two commits on `0dbf2d4ea`: build `351cf6dff` + leftovers `8aad24e35`). Merges cleanly onto `origin/main` `091c8c934`; the only main commit since base that touches these files is `0cf05ce8f` (`render-task-page.js`), and CI's `pull_request` run started after it.

CI: green — all 8 checks on `8aad24e35` (run 43487711426: unit, unit-proxy +400d, 4 e2e shards, secret scan, `ci-success`).

### Scope against what was asked
- **Decision and reasons:** `closeOutDecision` + frozen, ordered `CLOSE_OUT_REASONS` in `lib/run-closeout-state.js` return the asked fields. The box (`deriveCloseOutState` → `buildRunEvidence`), both guard lanes, the check route (`state.setDone`), the press (through `closeOutNotReady`, `hasMergedEvent` still ahead of it) and `blindReadStep` (`routesRead`) only render or enforce it. ✓
- **Rules:** enforcement never reads `ticketState` or `workAfterReview` (witnessed for completed/canceled/started/null). `followsPerson: 'merged'` needs a non-empty landing where every PR is readable and merged. Advice loosens only for completed + no close-out + no notes PR. `setDone` = person + approved + all landing PRs merged. Harbour never sets Done. Unreadable keeps the gate without refusing. `head-moved` refuses both actors. ✓
- **Course changes are recorded:** the landing bound replaces every-cited-PR (ruling `lin4460-landing-bound-not-cut`, posted on LIN-4447 at 18:45Z). `followsPerson: 'merged'` is kept per R1 "Both". The `state.status`/`state.message` API fields are dropped rather than mapped (named in the PR). ✓
- **Retires:** census grep on head finds no `byPersonCheck`, no `closeOutWaitsOn(` call outside the owner, no `REFUSED_REASONS`, `closeOutSetsDone` or `readGateTrail`, and no bare reason literal in `lib/routes/public`. The index-aligned statuses were already retired by LIN-4458. ✓
- **Area notes:** the three Waiting entries meant by "17, 18, 20" (precedence split, bare reason literals, `closeOutSetsDone` vs the gate) are removed by text. The `deriveState` entry is rewritten rather than removed. The accepted-limit entry is added with its why-not. The Lesson is replaced, plus the passenger Lesson. `area-notes.test.js` passes in CI. ✓
- **Leftovers `Retires:` line:** it names the `routes/dashboard-summaries.js` Waiting entry in `docs/areas/web-routes.md`, and this diff removes it. I read the `streamedFailureReply`/`summaryFailure` consolidation: replies are byte-equivalent (same status, body, log line per route). ✓
- **Regression check:** `git log` on the touched files (LIN-4458 a4c1671db/abc1b921b, LIN-4439 8c182b283, LIN-4438 351146acf) shows nothing re-introduced. The single `blindReadMissingState` builder is intact, the URL-keyed Map still refuses arrays, and the landing still decides.

### Mutation checks (run by review, each reverted, tree clean afterwards)
Run against lin-4460, run-closeout-state, lin-4438 gate, close-out-check-route, close-out-not-ready-dispatch and readiness-chain (baseline 181/181):

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| M1 gate ignores the merged landing | 4 fail |
| M2 `setDone` ignores actor | 2 fail |
| M3 empty landing counts as merged | 7 fail |
| M4 Done-passenger advice removed | 3 fail |
| M5 canceled rule removed | 2 fail |
| M6 `setDone` without approval | 3 fail |
| M7 head-moved never refuses | 11 fail |
| M8 check route ignores `setDone` | 12 fail |
| M9 `workAfterReview` ignored | 3 fail |
| M10 refusal copy un-capitalised | 2 fail |
| M11 Done never reads (audit notes PR lost) | 3 fail |
| **M12** `entryFor` drops `readable &&` from `merged` | **0 fail — survives** |

M12 survives because every "unreadable" fixture omits `merged`, so the passenger guarantee's "unreadable never becomes `'merged'`" holds because of how the fixture is built, not because of the decision's guard (fix F1).

### Isolated, or one of a class?
The class is "close-out rule decided in more than one place". Every in-scope instance is folded into the decision. The remaining siblings are **outside** this ticket and already have homes, written by this PR in `docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md` Waiting:
- `readCloseOutChain` builds a box the merge recorder discards.
- `closeOutOnTrail` vs `closeOutAfterReview`.
- the page/CI-wake PR identity (`deriveState` over every cited PR), excluded by the size record.
- the two client painters (`public/close-out.js`, `public/session.js`): no new status value reaches them, so nothing breaks today.

No new ticket is needed.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside (witness 1, passenger guarantee): the `readable` guard on merged evidence is unpinned (M12).** Settle before the merge with fix F1. Pass condition: after the fix, deleting `readable &&` from `const merged = readable && status.merged === true;` in `entryFor` makes the passenger test fail.
- **Inside (witness 1, agreement table input shapes): the "ticket unknown" and "press route" cells are not in the table.** `ticketState: null` is asserted for enforcement only, and the press is covered only through its guard (head-moved press is route-tested, blind-read-missing press is not). Settle before the merge with fix F2. Pass condition: a `close-out-press` POST on an approved, open, unread stop-at-PR trail returns 409 `CLOSE_OUT_NOT_READY` / `blind-read-missing` / "No blind read on record since the review" and records no event; `blindReadStep` with `issue.state` absent routes the read on an approved, unread, In Progress-shaped trail.
- **Inside (claim this change depends on): no client reads the dropped `GET /api/run-evidence/:id` `state.status`/`state.message`.** Discharged by review's grep: there are no readers in LinearViewer `lib/ routes/ public/ scripts/` at head. The `state.status` readers in `render-run-evidence.js` and the `public/*.js` painters read the close-out box, not this field. simple-dispatcher `1616b19` has no reference to `run-evidence`. Named rollback if an unseen external client breaks: revert `351cf6dff`. That is reversible: readiness is computed on read and nothing is persisted in a new shape.
- **Inside: real-provider behaviour of the passenger stand-aside.** In production, the stop-at guard now admits Harbour's close-out on a landing a person merged outside Harbour with no blind read. Before, it refused `blind-read-missing`. The route and guard tests use seams, never live GitHub or Linear. Settle after the deploy: on the first such task, confirm the close-out dispatch is admitted and the check records a `by: 'person'` event plus Done. Named rollback: revert `351cf6dff`.
- **Outside, discharged by ruling:** the ladder lane and recommend path do not see an outside merge on an In Progress ticket. John accepted this (`lin4447-recommend-path-outside-merge`, LIN-4447 comment 90c9f8a4). It is pinned by the test named for the ruling, and the Waiting entry records it.

### Fixes for close-out (name-precise)
- **F1** `tests/unit/lin-4460-close-out-decision.test.js`, the "dropping a fact never moves the passenger fact or the gate the wrong way" block: add an unreadable variant that still carries a merged flag, e.g. `{ readable: false, state: 'closed', merged: true }`. Assert `followsPerson !== 'merged'`, `setDone === false`, and that `waitsOn` stays `'blind-read'` on the approved-unread rows. Then re-run M12 and confirm it goes red.
- **F2a** `tests/unit/close-out-check-route.test.js`: add one `close-out-press` test beside the LIN-3657 head-moved block. Use an approved, open, unread stop-at-PR trail. Expect 409 `{ code: 'CLOSE_OUT_NOT_READY', reason: 'blind-read-missing' }`, error text `No blind read on record since the review`, and no event recorded.
- **F2b** `tests/unit/lin-4460-close-out-decision.test.js`, advice section: add `blindReadStep({}, { comments: [summary(1), review(2)], allRuns: [] })` → non-null (ticket unknown routes like In Progress, with no passenger loosening).
- **F3** PR #2438 body, `## Retires`: add the leftovers commit's retirements: `readGateTrail` (`lib/run-trail.js`), and the `routes/dashboard-summaries.js` Waiting entry (`docs/areas/web-routes.md`), now `streamedFailureReply` (`routes/proxy-compute.js`) and `summaryFailure` (`routes/dashboard-summaries.js`), replies unchanged.
- **F4** (nit) `routes/proxy-compute.js:37`: remove the stray second blank line added after the imports.

### Verdict
How the work meets what was asked, sentence by sentence:
- **Merge hold:** released by John's answers. R1 "Both" keeps the merged row.
- **Ruling text correction:** superseded, since the ruling is answered.
- **Approach:** owner and reason table ✓, return shape ✓ (plus `message`/`pr`/`entries`/`headMoved` for the box), all consumers ✓, `readTrail` ✓.
- **Input table:** followed, except the landing bound, which is an answered course change.
- **Match statuses by URL:** ✓.
- **Rules:** every bullet ✓, including fail-open and `CLOSE_OUT_ALREADY_MERGED` ahead.
- **`deriveState`:** loses its status decision and keeps `pr`/`prUrls`/`checksUrl`/`mergedAt`. Readers were listed, and the fields are dropped rather than mapped (named).
- **Retires:** all ✓.
- **Settles Waiting** 17/18/20 by text ✓. Lesson ✓.
- **Witnesses:** 1 ✓, apart from the M12 gap and the two missing cells (F1, F2). Witnesses 2–5 ✓.
- **Recommendation fixtures:** untouched, as required.
- **Binding constraints:** no stored readiness, no new GitHub or provider reads, Waiting entries removed in the same change, Lessons under the cap, retirements named in the PR (F3 completes it). ✓

No narrowing beyond the answered rulings.

**Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger** (F1 and F2 before the merge, F3 and F4 tidy-ups, the post-deploy check after).

## Blind read
Verdict: better. It gives every close-out answer one owner (`closeOutDecision` in `lib/run-closeout-state.js`), retiring `closeOutSetsDone`, `REFUSED_REASONS`, `readGateTrail`, the per-lane `closeOutWaitsOn` calls in `lib/close-out-readiness.js` and the status words in `lib/run-evidence.js`'s picker, with a census test to hold the line, and it folds four copied failure arms in `routes/proxy-compute.js` into one. Against that, the same decision now also carries the recommendation's advice (`routesRead`) and some outputs nothing reads, and `lib/recommendation-facts.js` keeps a `blindRead` field whose comment names a reader that no longer exists.

Read: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2438 at `8aad24e35` against `0dbf2d4ea`.

### Inside the area, fix-sized
- `lib/recommendation-facts.js` (llm-and-prompts): `assembleTrailFacts().review.blindRead` says "the blind-read route reads it ... through closeOutDecision", but `blindReadStep` now calls `readTrail` directly and never goes through `assembleTrailFacts`. Only `tests/unit/lin-4437-blind-read.test.js` reads the field. Fix: drop the field and point those three assertions at `readTrail(...).review.blindRead`, or at least correct the comment.
- `lib/run-closeout-state.js` (runs-and-dispatch): `deriveCloseOutState` copies `waitsOn` and `followsPerson` into the box model, and `closeOutDecision` works out `followsPerson: 'done'`, but nothing in `lib/`, `routes/` or `public/` reads either one. Only `refuses`, `setDone`, `status` and `reason` have readers; these two are read only by tests. Fix: drop them from the box model, and drop the `'done'` value unless something is about to read it.
- `docs/architecture/prompt-system.md` (unmapped; concerns `lib/recommendation-blind-read.js`, llm-and-prompts): the change edited the Routing paragraph, which says "Code settles four routes" and describes the blind read as the third. Its bold "Restated invariant" still lists three (live-stage wait, review loop bound, look-first). Fix: add the blind read to the invariant.
- `tests/unit/run-closeout-state.test.js` (runs-and-dispatch): the test "a merge after a moved head still sets Done as before (closeOutSetsDone unchanged)" names a function this change deletes. Fix: rename it to say what it pins now (the person's check sets Done on a merged landing).
- `lib/run-evidence.js` (runs-and-dispatch): the new `deriveState` comment ends "(the body's `state.status` is gone; see the PR)", which sends the next reader to a PR description for the reason. Fix: say the reason inline (the check route's box is what clients read) or drop the clause.

### Inside the area, larger
- `lib/run-closeout-state.js` (runs-and-dispatch): `closeOutDecision` puts the enforcement answer and the recommendation's advice in one function. `routesRead` reads the ticket state, `workAfterReview`, `closeOutOnTrail` and `landingHasNotesPr`, imports `isTerminalState` for advice only, and calls `closeOutWaitsOn` a second time. So the runs module now owns when the LLM route sends a read, which is a stand-aside policy that belongs to `lib/recommendation-blind-read.js`. Splitting it back out means deciding where the advice half of the passenger rule lives, which is a design decision across two areas.
- `lib/run-closeout-state.js` (runs-and-dispatch): `deriveCloseOutState` takes both `prs`, now used only for their `corroborated` marks, and `landingPrs`, the list it actually decides over. Every caller (`readCloseOutChain`, `ladderNotReady`, `buildRunEvidence`) builds one from the other. Separately, `readCloseOutChain` returns `review` and `landing` under their old names (`ledger`, `landingPrs`). Giving the box one landing input changes the signature at every caller in two areas' files, so it is more than a fix.

### Outside the area
None.

## Close-out — LIN-4460

**Merged:** PR [#2438](https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2438) as `d52c676fa`, pinned to head `f2de8788e` (`--match-head-commit`). **Deployed:** harbour.cat's footer shows `d52c676fa`.

### Ledger

- **Inside, no reader of the dropped `state.status` / `state.message`:** discharged by review's grep. Named rollback: revert `351cf6dff`.

Why: no such landing exists yet, and it needs live GitHub and Linear. Who can run it: the operator (John), on the first such task. Named rollback: revert `351cf6dff`. Not a reason to hold the close.
- **Outside, by ruling:** the ladder and recommend path don't see an outside merge on an In Progress ticket (`lin4447-recommend-path-outside-merge`), pinned by the named test.

They're not fix-sized, and no redesign is approved. The `readCloseOutChain` and `closeOutOnTrail` leftovers are already Waiting entries in `docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md`. description:
## As asked

**Parent:** LIN-4447 (Runs & dispatch, left simpler). The parent's scope is its `## As asked` block. Its approved design and plan are the `## Design` and `## Implementation Plan` sections of the parent description, and the Design comment (6efb91fa) holds the full analysis. **Start from the parent's approved plan and follow it. Where the code shows it is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4447.**
**Repository:** JKershaw/LinearViewer. **Grounding commit:** `origin/main` 4b5001ddf. On 2026-11-13 at 14:00Z it was still HEAD, with nothing landed since the ticket was filed.

## Piece 1 (larger): one close-out decision

**Merge hold:** build it and open the PR, but **do not merge** until John answers `lin4447-r1-passenger-scope` and `lin4447-recommend-path-outside-merge` on LIN-4447. If R1 comes back "done-only", drop the merged-landing row and `followsPerson: 'merged'` with it. The advice row and the agreement table stay.
**Correct the ruling text before John answers (reviewer note 1).** The posted `lin4447-recommend-path-outside-merge` question says the ladder "follows a person's Done". As built, it doesn't. The accurate wording: "the recommend path follows a person's Done; neither the recommend path nor the ladder follows an outside merge on a ticket still In Progress; the ladder, like every guard, never reads ticket state."

**Approach:**

* `lib/run-closeout-state.js` owns `closeOutDecision({ trail, prStatuses, stopAt, runnerReady, actor, ticketState })`. It also owns a frozen, precedence-ordered `CLOSE_OUT_REASONS` list that carries each reason's message copy.
* The decision returns `{ status, reason, refuses, setDone, waitsOn, routesRead, followsPerson }`.
* Consumers render or enforce that answer and decide nothing themselves: the box (`buildRunEvidence`), both guard lanes (`closeOutNotReady`, `ladderNotReady` in `lib/close-out-readiness.js`), the check route (`routes/workspace-api-run-evidence.js:300`), the press route (line 350, through its guard), `blindReadStep` (`lib/recommendation-blind-read.js`) and the `run-evidence` state.
* Piece 2 supplies the trail fields through `readTrail`.

**Inputs stay surface-specific (no new GitHub or provider read anywhere):**

| Surface | PR statuses | ticketState | actor |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| Box / run-evidence state | the landing's sole PR (multi-PR: none) | — | harbour |
| Check route | every cited PR | — | **person** |
| Stop-at guard lane | every cited PR, fresh | — | harbour |
| Ladder guard lane | none | — | harbour |
| Press route | as its guard | — | harbour |
| `blindReadStep` | none | `issue.state.type` | n/a (advice) |

`lib/close-out-merges.js` and the guard map to `actor: 'harbour'` on purpose. Today they pass `byPersonCheck: true` only to reuse the read chain. Match statuses **by URL**, not by array position.

**Rules:**

* **Enforcement** (`waitsOn`, `refuses`, `reason`, `setDone`, box `status`) reads the trail and PR statuses only: never ticket state, and never `workAfterReview`, which the guards don't read today.
* The gate stands aside (`followsPerson: 'merged'`) only when every landing PR has a readable merged status. A missing or unreadable status means "not known merged", and the gate holds.
* **Advice** (`routesRead`) can be loosened only by `ticketState: completed`, and only with no close-out on the landing and no audit notes PR (`followsPerson: 'done'`). A post-Done audit notes PR still gets its read. Canceled/Duplicate tickets and completed-with-close-out tickets behave as today.
* `setDone` requires `actor: 'person'`, readable merged evidence, an approving review and **no other unmerged PR among every cited PR** (today's bound). A landing-only relaxation would need its own named witness.
* Keep the fail-open guard: once a read is on record, unreadability alone never refuses, and `head-moved` still refuses on a readable PR.
* Keep the press route's `CLOSE_OUT_ALREADY_MERGED` check (`hasMergedEvent`) ahead of the decision.
* `deriveState` (`lib/run-evidence.js:59`) loses its status decision but keeps `state.pr`, `state.prUrls`, `checksUrl` and `mergedAt`. List every reader of `evidence.state.status` before mapping its different vocabulary.

**Retires:**

* `REFUSED_REASONS`
* the duplicate `closeOutWaitsOn` calls and the empty-box rebuild
* the reason literals and the message capitalising in `closeOutNotReadyRefusal`
* `byPersonCheck` and its pass-throughs
* `blindReadStep`'s own completed-ticket rule
* index-aligned `prStatuses`
* `deriveState`'s status decision

**Settles Waiting:** 17, 18, 20. Add the passenger precedence as one new Lesson of about 300 bytes.

**Testing / witnesses:**

1. **Agreement table:** the shared trails in `tests/fixtures/run-ledger-trails.js` × actor × input shape (full, box, no PR read, unreadable, ticket unknown), press route included, with the expected answer written in each cell. Surfaces that hold the same facts must give the same answer. Passenger guarantee (narrowed per reviewer note 2): removing a PR status, or making it unreadable, never moves `followsPerson` from null to `'merged'` and never turns `waitsOn: 'blind-read'` into null. Don't assert monotonicity over all enforcement outcomes.
2. **The named cases:** a person's check on a merged, approved, unread landing sets Done, and the stop-at lane stands aside. Row 196's **first** half in `lin-4438-blind-read-gate.test.js` flips; its second half stays. Add a post-Done audit notes PR case that still gets its read. Row 14 is piece 2's.
3. **Census:** no reason literal, no `closeOutWaitsOn` call and no `byPersonCheck` outside `lib/run-closeout-state.js`.
4. **Forbidden paths:** `actor: 'harbour'` with an approving review, a merged PR and no other unmerged PR gives `setDone: false`. An approved, unmerged, unread landing is refused `blind-read-missing` by both lanes, whether or not the ticket is Done. A person's check without an approving review sets no Done. `head-moved` refuses both actors. An unreadable PR keeps the blind-read gate in place but doesn't refuse on its own. Harbour never sets Done.
5. **The limit, pinned:** an outside merge on a ticket still In Progress still routes the read in `blindReadStep`. Name the test for the ruling.

* Change recommendation fixtures (`scripts/eval/fixtures/recommend/next-stage-choice.json`) only for a demonstrated change of expected route.

Session fit: fits one session
Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4447's approving plan-review (comment 12619798-1986-467f-b67c-8bed766a7813, rev 2)

**Binding for every piece (from the parent's Constraints):** compute readiness from the trail on read and never store it. Add no GitHub or provider reads. In the same change, remove the Waiting entries this piece settles and any stale Lesson clause in `docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md`, and keep Lessons under 6,144 bytes. Say in the PR what this piece retires. Never recompute stored pre-cutover history, and never edit recorded prompt changelog text. The LLM & prompts side of the seam belongs to LIN-4448 (A14).

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

## Implemented (close-out, 13 Nov)

Piece 1 shipped as PR [#2438](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2438>), merged as `d52c676fa` and deployed. The plan was implemented as approved, with two recorded course changes: the landing-only PR-read and `setDone` bound from LIN-4458 replaced every-cited-PR (ruling `lin4460-landing-bound-not-cut`), and `GET /api/run-evidence/:id` drops `state.status` and `state.message` instead of mapping them. Both rulings (`lin4447-r1-passenger-scope`: "Both"; `lin4447-recommend-path-outside-merge`: "Accept") were answered and built as ruled. The real-provider passenger post-deploy check was not run; see the close-out comment. The full history is preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail.

## Size of the move

**Size:** just the task
**Why:** Delivers the asked single close-out answer that every surface renders or enforces, so one precedence decides when the gate follows a person; which pull request the page and wake sweep follow is nearby and does not bind.
**Cuts:** none
**Decided by:** the standing policy
